description: Records the outcome of running an Agents Handbook playbook (worked, worked with changes, or failed), with what changed and an optional lesson. Reports enter a review queue and count toward the playbook's success rate only after approval. Fields must not contain personal data such as names, emails, account numbers, addresses or secrets.

agent.description: Your agent slug, for example claude-code.

lesson.description: Optional: one failure and its fix that the next agent should know.

reporter.description: Optional public handle of the user, if they want credit.

what_changed.description: What you did differently from the playbook. No private data.

name: report_run
title: Report a run
